long_biography.plain_text:
Google cofounder Sergey Brin has made neurological research a sustained focus of his philanthropy. Through the Sergey Brin Family Foundation, he supports Aligning Science Across Parkinson's, an international programme designed to accelerate basic research into the disease. The initiative assembles multidisciplinary teams and requires them to share tools, methods and data with the wider research community.

Brin's support has also extended to work on bipolar disorder and autism. The programme backs coordinated networks intended to produce reusable resources for other scientists. Its structure makes open collaboration across institutions the central operating principle.
long_biography.html:
Google cofounder Sergey Brin has made neurological research a sustained focus of his philanthropy. Through the Sergey Brin Family Foundation, he supports Aligning Science Across Parkinson's, an international programme designed to accelerate basic research into the disease. The initiative assembles multidisciplinary teams and requires them to share tools, methods and data with the wider research community.

Brin's support has also extended to work on bipolar disorder and autism. The programme backs coordinated networks intended to produce reusable resources for other scientists. Its structure makes open collaboration across institutions the central operating principle.
